documents.data:
{
  "symbol": "{{(InputSymbol.text || '').toUpperCase().trim()}}",
  "name": "{{InputName.text || (InputSymbol.text || '').toUpperCase().trim()}}",
  "currency": "{{SelectCurrency?.selectedOptionValue || (SelectAssetType.selectedOptionValue === 'STOCK' ? 'USD' : 'EUR')}}",
  "assetType": "{{SelectAssetType.selectedOptionValue || 'STOCK'}}",
  "type": "BUY",
  "shares": {{Number(InputShares.text || 0)}},
  "purchasePrice": {{Number(InputPrice.text || 0)}},
  "totalAmount": {{(Number(InputShares.text || 0) * Number(InputPrice.text || 0)) + Number(InputFee.text || 0)}},
  "fee": {{Number(InputFee.text || 0)}},
  "portfolio": "{{SelectPortfolioInput.selectedOptionValue || 'EUR'}}",
  "goal": "{{SelectGoalInput.selectedOptionValue || 'retirement'}}",
  "tags": {{InputNotes?.text ? InputNotes.text.split(',').map(t => t.trim().toLowerCase()) : ["revolut", "stocks"]}},
  "date": "{{DatePickerDate.selectedDate || new Date().toISOString()}}",
  "notes": "{{InputNotes.text || ''}}",
  "createdAt": "{{new Date().toISOString()}}",
  "updatedAt": "{{new Date().toISOString()}}"
}
